segments.name: North America
segments.description: Supplies windows and doors for residential and commercial markets in the U.S. and Canada, serving new construction and repair and remodel projects.
segments.evidence: In our North America segment, we compete primarily in the new construction and R&R market for residential doors and windows in the U.S. and Canada.

segments.name: Europe
segments.description: Competes in the residential and non-residential door market across Germany, the U.K., France, Austria, Switzerland, and Scandinavia for builders and renovators.
segments.evidence: In our Europe segment, we compete primarily in the market for residential and non-residential doors in Germany, the U.K., France, Austria, Switzerland, and Scandinavia.

revenueModel.text: Wholesale distributors and retailers, individual contractors and consumers pay for interior and exterior doors, windows and related building products.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers include wholesale distributors and retailers as well as individual contractors and consumers.

changes.text: Sold the Australasia business, including JW Australia, in 2023; its results are reported as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: On July 2, 2023, we completed the sale of JW Australia.

changes.text: Divested the Towanda facility and related assets in 2025, having reported it within North America through the sale date.
changes.evidence: As a result, we were required to divest our Towanda facility and related assets, which occurred on January 17, 2025.

changes.text: Sold its business in St. Kitts in 2024.
changes.evidence: Tax effect on sale of business during the year ended December 31, 2024, primarily relates to the sale of our business in St. Kitts.
